Handed to the team · Revised ship date Nov 2 has passed, no tracking and no current date to give.

Hi Marcus, I'm sorry, your Bitfortun BS-4 on Shop···· still hasn't shipped and has no tracking yet. It's paid. We wrote to you on October 31 that it would leave the manufacturer on November 2, and that date has slipped. I don't have a confirmed new ship date I can stand behind.

I've passed it to the team to get the current date and your tracking. They're offline right now and pick it up Monday at 10am ET. The answer goes to (email hidden), and the tracking will go to the same address as soon as the unit ships.
how come it takes 2 week and no update?

You're right to be annoyed, Marcus. We told you on October 31 it would leave the manufacturer on November 2. Then on November 4 we said tracking would follow within a day or two. Neither happened, and we should have told you that.

The date shown when you ordered was November 30, so it should still ship by then. But I won't give you a new date until the team confirms one.

For the wait, I've made you a $50 code for your next order: ····. It's yours alone and works on orders over $200.
It doesn't expire, so you can use it whenever you're ready. It's good for one order over $200, and $50 comes off at checkout.
Thank you, hope i hear something on monday

Thanks for your patience, Marcus. The team picks this up Monday, and their answer will go to (email hidden) The tracking will go there too as soon as the BS-4 ships.

Before you go, one quick question: after the trouble with the BS-2, what made you pick the BS-4 for your next miner?
